principles: Capture every production or proof technical failure before changing the package.
A reproducible defect receives a fixture or a documented reason why a fixture is not appropriate.
Object identity, dependency, rights, accessibility, quantitative meaning, and cross-family boundary failures are zero-tolerance release risks.
A rule or profile change records authority, scope, impact, decision hooks, affected object types, and rollback conditions.
Unresolved MWM technical profile decisions remain hooks; regression repair may not silently decide them.

severity_response.critical: contain immediately, hold or rollback, notify owner, add fixture
severity_response.high: triage before next release, add or amend fixture, require verification
severity_response.medium: schedule repair and monitor, add fixture when reproducible
severity_response.low: record and review in maintenance cycle

release_rule: No unresolved critical or high target failure, identity inference, rights inference, quantitative meaning change, protected-name change, stale dependency, false accessibility claim, or false PASS may ship.
